quest.title: Connor's Brew
quest.description: The Dawn Winery's Connor requires three sets of Dandelion Seeds.

talks.objective: Give three sets of Dandelions Seeds to Connor

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, I hear you need dandelions...

dialogues.speaker: Connor
dialogues.text: Oh, you must have seen my commission, then. Well, what about it? Have you gathered three sets of Dandelion Seeds?

response.speaker: Connor
response.text: Not yet, eh... Well, be sure to give them to me once you've got them. I need to start brewing wine soon.

dialogues.speaker: Connor
dialogues.text: Yes... These Dandelion Seeds should last me for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Connor
dialogues.text: Please accept this. Thanks for helping me out.
